posts.title: Random Photos
posts.description: I try make an effort to take a few photos most days that I’m not engaged in a specific photography project. This often results in a weekly photo dump of several hundred photos not worth mentioning here, but I want to post something so here’s the pick of the week…

posts.title: Sunflower Field
posts.description: I happened to drive past a field of sunflowers today and decided to stop and snap a few photos.
